subject.title: [Bug]: Tasks page / tasks.list edge-case hardening follow-ups from #100789 review

question: Which stable traversal contract should `tasks.list` use now that the ledger can sort by mutable activity time?
rationale: Items 1, 2, and 4 are straightforward hardening, but item 3 can require an API-level choice between opaque/snapshot cursors, stable secondary ordering, or a split UI query path.

options.title: Use Cursor-Safe Tokens
options.body: Adopt an opaque or updatedAt-plus-id cursor contract so cursor-following clients do not skip rows while task activity changes.

options.title: Split UI Recent From Ledger Traversal
options.body: Keep the existing list traversal stable for clients and add a narrower terminal/recent query shape for the Control UI.

options.title: Defer Pagination Redesign
options.body: Fix the three local UI/ordering bugs now and keep cursor instability tracked as a separate API decision.

recommendation.title: Use Cursor-Safe Tokens
recommendation.body: Adopt an opaque or updatedAt-plus-id cursor contract so cursor-following clients do not skip rows while task activity changes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Tasks page feature and opened this follow-up from the final review context.
